workload.name: phase-3-10k-canvas-and-write-coalescing

fixture.generator: deterministic 100 x 100 grid of Excalidraw rectangles

workload.readiness: test-only native contract proves Excalidraw API editable and exactly 10,000 elements loaded

panZoom.statistic: rAF-derived observed FPS and maximum frame interval during constant-zoom pan (ADR-007)

editing.statistic: rAF maximum interval and fs-watch-plus-metadata-snapshot event ratio

expectedVariance.fps: window compositing and background load may vary; repeat before assigning a bottleneck
expectedVariance.rss: up to 10 percent run-to-run before investigation; absolute budgets remain unchanged
expectedVariance.writes: fs.watch can coalesce or multiply kernel notifications; raw events are retained with observer limitations

processTreeAccounting.associationMethod: recursive parent PID closure, plus WebView/GPU/Network auxiliary processes carrying an explicit app association token, plus launch-time-window attribution of WebKit-role processes re-parented to launchd (PID 1) that appeared after the app launch and were absent from the pre-launch snapshot
exclusions: WebKit-role processes that already existed before the app launch
platformLimitations: macOS re-parents WKWebView auxiliary processes to launchd with no app token; launch-time-window attribution assumes no other same-user WebKit app is launched during the measurement window
ps etime has one-second granularity; a two-second slack is applied to the launch window
ps RSS can include shared pages charged independently to more than one process
ps CPU is an OS interval estimate normalized so 100 percent equals one logical core

limitations: fs.watch may coalesce events; the before/after metadata snapshot detects persistent changes but not an ephemeral file created and removed between snapshots
write observation covers only the explicitly supplied application-managed data roots and mounted test workspaces

panZoomFps.statistic: observed frames divided by rAF interval duration

maximumFreeze.statistic: maximum requestAnimationFrame interval during pan/zoom and edit

writesPerEditEventRatio.unit: observed filesystem events per scripted edit event

verdict.reason: All evaluated T090 10k canvas and write-coalescing budgets passed.
